submission.justification: Recommended Absorber-F2 with the minimum allowed 2 mm plate thickness. Absorber-F1 is excluded because its residual dose rate is 85 uSv/h, above the 20 uSv/h hard limit. Absorber-F2 and Absorber-F3 both satisfy the dose constraint, but F2 has the lower recorded residual dose rate (6 uSv/h vs 12 uSv/h). With no usable 100 GeV simulation/performance scan available, the minimum allowed plate thickness is selected as the most conservative choice for energy resolution, since thinner absorber sampling generally improves electromagnetic calorimeter sampling resolution. The 100 GeV energy-resolution hard requirement remains unverified from the recorded evidence.

requirements.requirement: Absorber must be one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: candidate_specs.md was found; Absorber-F2 is one of the three allowed candidates and corresponds to recorded material code 3.

requirements.requirement: Energy resolution for 100 GeV electrons must be 4.5% or better.
requirements.evidence: No simulation instruction/result documents or S3 performance documents were available; zero resolution points or values were extracted, so the 100 GeV resolution for Absorber-F2 at 2 mm is not verified.

requirements.requirement: Residual dose rate at 1 m after one week cooldown must not exceed 20 uSv/h.
requirements.evidence: Activation data give Absorber-F2/material code 3 a residual dose rate of 6 uSv/h for all relevant thicknesses, below the 20 uSv/h limit.
Selected plate thickness is 2 mm, equal to the recorded minimum allowed thickness and within the 2–10 mm range.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV.
requirements.evidence: No 100 GeV performance scan or tested configurations were available; 2 mm was selected because it is the thinnest allowed plate and is expected to minimize sampling fluctuations, but this was not confirmed by simulation.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended material and plate thickness.
